description: This Java class 'StartupConfig' is a Spring configuration component that logs key runtime environment details once the application is fully initialized. It reports active profiles, sanitized datasource URL, and Hibernate DDL mode, aiding in verifying deployment and database connection parameters.

classes.name: StartupConfig
classes.description: A Spring Boot configuration class that logs environment details when the application becomes ready.
